messages:
incident-bot: Pager: High 5xx spike observed on api-gateway-edge (502/504). AlertID: ALG-502-3468. Spike started ~T-3m. Link: https://observability/redwood/alerts/ALG-502-3468

alice.oncall: seeing it. joining bridge. creating a short command corridor.

bob-sre: metrics: 502+504 rate = 18% across edge nodes, total traffic ~12k rps. Error percent concentrated on /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings fanout. p50 latency up from 90ms -> 350ms.

dan-eng: adding context — we rolled out small mux change 1h ago that adjusted upstream keepalive timeouts. possible hypothesis: connection churn causing upstream 502s.

carla-pm: any visible customer impact? pages or tickets?

eve-support: support queue: 14 new tickets in last 10m, mostly timeouts on generation endpoints. One large customer (acme-corp) on Dedicated reported errors.

alice.oncall: ok split tasks: bob take telemetry and traffic shaping, dan investigate recent mux/keepalive change + rollback option, eve gather customer list. I'll coordinate mitigations and update execs.

bob-sre: enabling rapid edge knockback rule to reduce fanout per request. Command: `./infractl route update --edge-knockback 0.6 --reason "502 spike"` Doing it now.

ops-jenkins: deploy job started: edge-knockback v1 -> applied to eu-west and us-central.

dan-eng: investigating ingress logs. seeing upstream pool exhaustion on model-hosts when requests from gateway arrive with many concurrent connections. snippet: ```
ERROR upstream reset: connection refused
WARN pool_size=256 in_use=256
```

bob-sre: after knockback, error-rate dropped to ~7% within 90s, p50 now 210ms. Still high but moving. Preparing temp circuit-breaker config to short-circuit strongly failing upstreams: `infractl cb create --threshold 0.2 --window 10s --action short-circuit`

alice.oncall: dan, can you test rolling back the keepalive tweak? if rollback is low-risk, do it. If not, we keep knockback + cb.

dan-eng: rolling back mux keepalive tweak on Canary now. Command: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/mux -n ingress --to-revision=rev-122` Monitoring logs.

eve-support: acme-corp confirmed intermittent failures have reduced after edge change. They still see occasional 502s.

bob-sre: cb created and applied to problematic upstreams. errors down to 3.4% across edge. p50 140ms.

alice.oncall: good. capturing mitigation steps in incident doc: https://confluence/redwood/incidents/ALG-502-3468. Runbook referenced: /runbooks/api-gateway-5xx. Notifying sales for acme-corp impact.

carla-pm: please quantify customers impacted and ETA for full recovery.

eve-support: affected customers list attached to ticket thread. ~22 customers had >=1 error, 3 had sustained failed requests (including acme-corp).

dan-eng: rollback confirmed stable on canary -> promoting. No further config drift observed.

alice.oncall: final status: applied edge knockback + circuit breaker + rollback of keepalive tweak. Customer impact reduced, errors holding ~2.8% for last 5m. We'll keep monitoring for 2h. Moving to follow-up for RCA and postmortem. If anyone sees a regression reopen. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident ALG-502-3468 status update: mitigated -> monitoring. Pager suppressed.
